items.title: Sandisk (SNDK) Implements 8 For 1 Stock Split
items.summary: Sandisk (NasdaqGS:SNDK) has approved and implemented an 8-for-1 forward stock split of its common shares. The company amended its corporate charter to reflect the split and adjust key share capital provisions. Authorized share count has been significantly expanded, creating capacity for a much larger pool of Sandisk common stock. The 8-for-1 split and charter amendment shift Sandisk's share structure in ways headline stock prices do not show. Our analysis turns up 1 warning sign for Sandisk...
